newsitem.title: USA: Fisher sees near-term revenue growth lower.
newsitem.headline: Fisher sees near-term revenue growth lower.

text.p: Fisher Scientific International Inc said Friday that it expects near-term revenue growth to remain below its historic levels, because of soft demand in the clinical laboratory market.
Fisher said it expects to incur $10 million to $12 million of nonrecurring costs related to efficiency improvement throughout the year.
The company reported first quarter earnings of $0.53 a share on sales of $527 million, compared to $0.27 a share on sales of $516 million the previous first quarter.
The currrent first quarter included $1.9 milllion of the efficiency improvement costs.
